name: Julie McCallister
occupation: Worked for the University of Wyoming in oil-and-gas upgrading research (six years, per her 2022 statement)
education: Bachelor’s in political science and a master’s in public administration, University of Wyoming (per her 2022 statement); she also wrote that she earned a bachelor’s degree in 2004
background: Julie McCallister ran as a Republican for House District 14 in 2022. In her 2022 candidate materials she said she came home to Wyoming at 19, that her uncle John Story of Dubois and her grandparents Charles and Maydeane Jones of Riverton helped foster her love of the state, and that she later worked for the University of Wyoming for six years in oil-and-gas upgrading research. In that statement she said she earned a bachelor’s degree in political science and a master’s in public administration at the university, and that she became active in state politics in 2013, including work lobbying for legislation.
